title: Portfolio Management and Watch
short: Renewals, recordals, watch services and audits that keep a portfolio enforceable and aligned with the business.
intro: A trademark portfolio decays unless someone is paying attention. Renewals lapse, assignments go unrecorded, the business changes its name and its products while the register still describes the company of ten years ago. We manage portfolios so that every registration is current, correctly owned and covers what the business actually sells.

We maintain the docket, run watch services for conflicting applications, record changes of ownership and name, and periodically audit the portfolio against the business to recommend what to file, what to renew and what to let go.
services: Docketing and management of renewal deadlines under Section 25, including restoration of lapsed marks
Recordal of assignments, changes of name and address, mergers and licences
Trademark watch services across the Indian Journal and, through associates, foreign registers
Portfolio audits and rationalisation against current and planned business activity
Due diligence on trademark portfolios in acquisitions, investments and financing
Management of Indian portfolios for foreign brand owners and their counsel, with reporting in the required format
Certified copies, status reports and legalised documents for use abroad
Advice on correct use and marking to preserve distinctiveness

process.title: Intake
process.text: We take over the portfolio, verify every record against the Registry and correct discrepancies.

process.title: Docket
process.text: Deadlines are docketed with reminders to the client well in advance of each action.

process.title: Watch
process.text: Conflicting applications are reported with a recommendation on whether to act.

process.title: Review
process.text: An annual review of the portfolio against the business, with filing and pruning recommendations.
